name: hold_guitar
text: A standing musician holds an acoustic guitar across the front of the waist without playing. The left arm reaches diagonally left to hold the guitar neck at chest height, left elbow bent; the right forearm rests across the rounded guitar body in front of the abdomen. Hands stay apart and maintain the asymmetric guitar-holding pose. Small natural weight shift, no strumming.

review.notes_zh: 左手向侧前方托琴颈、右前臂横在腹前琴身位置，稳定持琴而非弹奏；腕距约50厘米。手指固定放松，不含按弦，具体琴体挂接需后续对齐。
